about: What NoitaCraft reads from the player's own Noita install, found via NOITA_DIR in %LOCALAPPDATA%/NoitaCraft/noita.env (Melty fills it in with {game:noita}). Nothing is copied or shipped.

columns.path: path inside data/data.wak, or relative to the Noita folder
columns.gives: what the mashup uses from it

rows.format: WAK archive: 16-byte header (0, fileCount, tocEnd, 0), then entries (offset, size, nameLen, name)
Lua table; per action: id, name ($key), description ($key), sprite, mana
rows.gives: spell names/description keys, icon path, mana
spell and wand names/descriptions in every language

rows.format: Sprite XML with RectAnimation (frame_count, frame_width, frame_height, frame_wait, frames_per_row, pos_x, pos_y)
